endpoint.semantics: AAV9 nuclease-resistant viral-genome production, not tropism, infectivity, transgene expression, or clinical efficacy
endpoint.sequence_level: AA; two codon replicates remain aggregated in source row

isolation.external_reference: all modeling AAs including nonfinite Production

model.encoding: integer tokens; differentiable one-hot; two position-preserving 1D convolutions; flattened MLP
model.loss: MSE on train-mean/train-standard-deviation normalized measured Production
model.ensemble: arithmetic mean of three best-dev checkpoint scores

evaluation.pools: disjoint sequences within each cap; truncate remainder; identical candidates for BoN and RandomN
evaluation.primary_estimand: mean paired BoN regret minus RandomN regret in raw Production units
evaluation.uncertainty: two-sided 95% percentile bootstrap over disjoint pools
